name:        useLongPress
domain:      hook
package:     @astryxdesign/core
import:      @astryxdesign/core/hooks
description: Detects a single-finger press-and-hold and reports where it happened, so touch users can reach affordances that a pointer gets from right-click. iOS Safari never synthesizes a contextmenu event on long-press, which makes this the only touch route into a cursor-positioned surface such as ContextMenu. The press cancels on movement, lift, multi-touch or unmount. The hold is timed on the touch events' own timestamps: when a busy page handles the lift late, a finger held for the full delay still reports its long press, before the lift acts.
command:     npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 hook useLongPress
